experiment: R102 GTE-Qwen2-7B-instruct + LoRA fine-tune (single-vector retriever), fold-0, A100
verdict: GTE-7B+LoRA is the strongest NEW retriever signal of the session: ~32 unique top-30 recoveries vs the complete union (ColBERT got 4-8). But overall it PLATEAUS at recall@300 0.59 / recall@20 0.27 -- below fine-tuned BGE-large (0.68) and production (0.48@20). Full-data + more epochs did not lift it (mild overfit). Likely limited by decoder+last-token pooling + LoRA-only (vs BGE full FT bidirectional).
implication: Not a standalone replacement. Its value is ORTHOGONAL recall (~32/1600 unique top-30 GTs) -> candidate for ADDING as a retrieval source to the union (R84 playbook), but those uniques then face the same ranking-conversion bottleneck (union 0.78@300 -> 0.48@20) and the LR-conversion wall (R68/R90). Realistic nDCG gain small + uncertain. Heavy-model retrieval campaign (7B single-vector, ColBERT late-interaction, cross-encoder) all underperform fine-tuned BGE-large overall.
